_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: events
constraints: CHECK (status != 'closed' OR closed_at_micros IS NOT NULL)
CHECK (ends_at_micros IS NULL OR starts_at_micros IS NULL OR ends_at_micros >= starts_at_micros)

data.name: inventory_movements
constraints: CHECK (CASE kind WHEN 'receive' THEN delta_micros > 0 WHEN 'consume' THEN delta_micros < 0 WHEN 'waste' THEN delta_micros < 0 ELSE 1 END)
CHECK (kind != 'consume' OR event_id IS NOT NULL)

data.name: closeout_lines
constraints: CHECK (loaded_micros IS NULL OR returned_micros IS NULL OR waste_micros IS NULL OR depletion_micros = loaded_micros - returned_micros - waste_micros)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workspace_meta" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "workspace_uid" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'My workspace', "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by_app_version" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "commands" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("origin" IN ('form', 'agent')), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('staged', 'applied', 'rejected')), "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "applied_at_micros" INTEGER NULL, "rejected_reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "folders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" >= 0), "demand_basis" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("demand_basis" IN ('per_person', 'per_event')), "always_planned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("always_planned" IN (0, 1)), "hue_name" TEXT NULL CHECK("hue_name" IN ('fern', 'lake', 'plum', 'berry', 'clay', 'honey', 'olive', 'stone')), "icon_name" TEXT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("icon_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 40), "archived_at_micros" INTEGER NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("unit" IN ('each', 'g', 'kg', 'ml', 'L')), "pack_size_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("pack_size_micros" > 0), "serves_per_unit_micros" INTEGER NULL CHECK("serves_per_unit_micros" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000000000), "category" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "folder_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES folders (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "demand_basis" TEXT NULL CHECK("demand_basis" IN ('per_person', 'per_event')), "per_event_baseline_micros" INTEGER NULL CHECK("per_event_baseline_micros" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000), "per_person_numerator" INTEGER NULL CHECK("per_person_numerator" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000), "per_person_denominator" INTEGER NULL CHECK("per_person_denominator" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000), "archived_at_micros" INTEGER NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "venue" TEXT NULL, "scheduled_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "starts_at_micros" INTEGER NULL, "ends_at_micros" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned' CHECK("status" IN ('planned', 'active', 'closed', 'cancelled')), "planned_exposure" INTEGER NULL CHECK("planned_exposure" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000), "closed_at_micros" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (scheduled_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'), CHECK (status != 'closed' OR closed_at_micros IS NOT NULL), CHECK (ends_at_micros IS NULL OR starts_at_micros IS NULL OR ends_at_micros >= starts_at_micros));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_items" ("event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("event_id", "item_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('receive', 'consume', 'waste', 'adjust', 'reversal')), "delta_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "reverses_movement_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES inventory_movements (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source_command_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commands (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "occurred_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "recorded_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (delta_micros != 0), CHECK (abs(delta_micros) <= 1000000000000000), CHECK (CASE kind WHEN 'receive' THEN delta_micros > 0 WHEN 'consume' THEN delta_micros < 0 WHEN 'waste' THEN delta_micros < 0 ELSE 1 END), CHECK ((kind = 'reversal') = (reverses_movement_id IS NOT NULL)), UNIQUE (reverses_movement_id), CHECK (kind != 'consume' OR event_id IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_closeouts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("revision" > 0), "supersedes_closeout_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES event_closeouts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "confirmed_exposure" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("confirmed_exposure" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000), "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "source_command_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commands (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "confirmed_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (event_id, revision), UNIQUE (supersedes_closeout_id), CHECK ((revision = 1) = (supersedes_closeout_id IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "closeout_lines" ("closeout_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_closeouts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "loaded_micros" INTEGER NULL CHECK("loaded_micros" >= 0), "returned_micros" INTEGER NULL CHECK("returned_micros" >= 0), "waste_micros" INTEGER NULL CHECK("waste_micros" >= 0), "depletion_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("depletion_micros" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000), "stockout" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("stockout" IN (0, 1)), "approximate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("approximate" IN (0, 1)), "consumption_movement_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES inventory_movements (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "waste_movement_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES inventory_movements (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY ("closeout_id", "item_id"), CHECK (loaded_micros IS NULL OR returned_micros IS NULL OR waste_micros IS NULL OR depletion_micros = loaded_micros - returned_micros - waste_micros));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "closeout_drafts" ("event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("event_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "output_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived_at_micros" INTEGER NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_revisions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipes (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("revision" > 0), "yield_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("yield_micros" > 0), "yield_label" TEXT NULL, "source_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("source_kind" IN ('form', 'ocr')), "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (recipe_id, revision));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_lines" ("revision_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipe_revisions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "line_index" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("line_index" >= 0), "ingredient_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "quantity_per_batch_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("quantity_per_batch_micros" > 0), PRIMARY KEY ("revision_id", "line_index"), UNIQUE (revision_id, ingredient_item_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "forecast_snapshots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "method_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("method_version" > 0), "policy" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("policy" IN ('lean', 'balanced', 'cautious')), "upcoming_exposure" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("upcoming_exposure" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000), "history_window" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("history_window" > 0), "inputs_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "assumptions_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "source_command_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commands (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "forecast_lines" ("snapshot_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES forecast_snapshots (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "pack_size_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("pack_size_micros" > 0), "on_hand_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "confirmed_inbound_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("confirmed_inbound_micros" >= 0), "expected_use_micros" INTEGER NULL CHECK("expected_use_micros" >= 0), "planned_micros" INTEGER NULL CHECK("planned_micros" >= 0), "load_micros" INTEGER NULL CHECK("load_micros" >= 0), "acquire_micros" INTEGER NULL CHECK("acquire_micros" >= 0), "evidence_grade" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("evidence_grade" IN ('insufficient_data', 'single_event', 'observed_range')), "warnings_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "baseline_serves_per_unit_micros" INTEGER NULL CHECK("baseline_serves_per_unit_micros" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000000000), "baseline_expected_use_micros" INTEGER NULL CHECK("baseline_expected_use_micros" >= 0), "baseline_planned_micros" INTEGER NULL CHECK("baseline_planned_micros" >= 0), "baseline_load_micros" INTEGER NULL CHECK("baseline_load_micros" >= 0), "baseline_acquire_micros" INTEGER NULL CHECK("baseline_acquire_micros" >= 0), "demand_basis" TEXT NULL CHECK("demand_basis" IN ('per_person', 'per_event')), "baseline_per_event_micros" INTEGER NULL CHECK("baseline_per_event_micros" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000), "baseline_per_person_numerator" INTEGER NULL CHECK("baseline_per_person_numerator" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000), "baseline_per_person_denominator" INTEGER NULL CHECK("baseline_per_person_denominator" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000), PRIMARY KEY ("snapshot_id", "item_id"), CHECK ((evidence_grade = 'insufficient_data') = (expected_use_micros IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "forecast_evidence" ("snapshot_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES forecast_snapshots (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" >= 0), "closeout_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_closeouts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source_event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "exposure" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("exposure" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000), "depletion_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("depletion_micros" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000), "stockout" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("stockout" IN (0, 1)), "approximate" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("approximate" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("snapshot_id", "item_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "forecast_overrides" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "snapshot_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES forecast_snapshots (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "override_load_micros" INTEGER NULL CHECK("override_load_micros" >= 0), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
